data_objects.name: solar_magnetic_time_series
data_objects.meaning: A time series of solar active-region magnetic-field summary parameters and related area and energy proxies.
data_objects.notes: The source uses conventional abbreviated magnetic-parameter names and a literal MISSING token in one measurement field.

variables.name: TRUE_TIME
variables.meaning: Observation timestamp explicitly labeled in International Atomic Time (TAI).

variables.name: TIME
variables.meaning: Numeric time coordinate associated with TRUE_TIME.

variables.name: MEANGAM
variables.meaning: Mean inclination angle of the vector magnetic field.

variables.name: MEANGBT
variables.meaning: Mean gradient magnitude of the total magnetic field.

variables.name: MEANGBZ
variables.meaning: Mean gradient magnitude of the vertical magnetic field.

variables.name: MEANGBH
variables.meaning: Mean gradient magnitude of the horizontal magnetic field.

variables.name: SAVNCPP
variables.meaning: Sum of the absolute net electric current by magnetic polarity.

variables.name: MEANPOT
variables.meaning: Mean photospheric excess magnetic-energy density proxy.

variables.name: TOTPOT
variables.meaning: Total photospheric magnetic free-energy proxy integrated over area.

variables.name: MEANSHR
variables.meaning: Mean shear angle between observed and potential magnetic fields.

variables.name: SHRGT45
variables.meaning: Area fraction or percentage whose shear angle exceeds 45 degrees.

variables.name: R_VALUE
variables.meaning: R-value measure of unsigned magnetic flux near strong-gradient polarity-inversion lines.

variables.name: AREA_ACR
variables.meaning: Area of the represented solar active region.

structure.description: Each row is a time-indexed magnetic summary for one unnamed solar sequence; TRUE_TIME is chronological and typically advances at a regular minute cadence with gaps.
TRUE_TIME supplies the absolute TAI axis, while TIME supplies a numeric relative or auxiliary time coordinate.
The literal string MISSING is used as an unavailable-value encoding in MEANSHR.

uncertainties: The active-region identifier, observing instrument, spatial mask, calibration, and exact averaging definitions are not present.
The origin and unit of TIME are not stated.

Long-form parameter definitions and units follow conventional interpretations of the source abbreviations but are not accompanied by an embedded data dictionary; SHRGT45 does not clarify whether values are stored as percentages or fractions.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv content was used; scientific expansions are domain inferences from the complete set of source column names and encodings.
